_doc: #798 THE PIN: the model files this engine ships beyond ML Kit's bundled ones, each downloaded once by ../ml-models.gradle's fetchModels, refused on a sha256 or byte-count mismatch, and staged as an APK asset under `asset` (lib-apks build.json::android.no_compress keeps .tflite stored, which ML Kit's LocalModel needs). Never committed: the hash is the identity. `detect` is the full-label classifier ML Kit object detection runs on every detected object (CustomObjectDetectorOptions over LocalModel): its labels come from the model's own metadata (`labels_entry`), so a box is named with one of 1000 ImageNet classes instead of ML Kit's five coarse ones. `input`/`output` are checked against the real file by lib-apks/test/test-ml-goldens.sh. A licence and its source are required.

detect.name: EfficientNet-Lite0 int8 (ImageNet, 1000 classes) on ML Kit object detection
detect.licence_source: https://github.com/tensorflow/tpu/tree/master/models/official/efficientnet/lite (tensorflow/tpu, Apache License 2.0); class names are the ILSVRC-2012 (ImageNet) synset words
detect.source: TensorFlow Lite Task Library image-classification example (tfhub tensorflow/lite-model/efficientnet/lite0/int8/2)

scene_efficientdet.name: EfficientDet-Lite0 int8 (COCO, 90 labels) on MediaPipe Tasks Object Detector
scene_efficientdet.licence_source: https://github.com/google/automl/tree/master/efficientdet (google/automl, Apache License 2.0); the MediaPipe model card https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/object_detector#efficientdet-lite0_model_recommended; COCO class names
scene_efficientdet.source: MediaPipe Tasks object_detector efficientdet_lite0 int8 v1 (the model MediaPipe recommends for the Object Detector task)

scene_yolo11n.name: YOLO11n INT8 (COCO, 80 labels) on LiteRT
scene_yolo11n.licence_source: https://huggingface.co/Arm/yolo11n-int8-litert-vivo-x300 (Arm's LiteRT INT8 export of Ultralytics YOLO11n, AGPL-3.0, as the original https://huggingface.co/Ultralytics/YOLO11); COCO class names
scene_yolo11n.source: Arm's post-training-quantised LiteRT export of Ultralytics YOLO11n (XNNPACK; boxes are centre x, y, w, h in input pixels, then 80 sigmoid class scores)

_doc_1805: #1805 Cloud Camera > Objects' scene detectors (the engine's scene method, contract 4). `kind: detector` models are whole-frame detectors, not a classifier: `runtime` says what runs them in this APK (mediapipe = MediaPipe Tasks Object Detector, whose LiteRT runtime decodes the model's own anchors and labels from its metadata; litert-yolo = the LiteRT Interpreter with this engine's own letterbox, decode and NMS, labels from `labels` because the export carries no metadata). `outputs` lists every output tensor (order-free). Both are staged by the same fetchModels into the same asset directory, so no new asset site exists (runtime-data guard D2). Which one is the default is recognition.json::scene.default_detector, decided by the emulator benchmark (ac_cloud-camera/test/emulator-camera-scene.sh); the other stays selectable.
